title: Resume on a "Waiting/Unknown … resume to retry or cancel" card does nothing visible: no retry of the retained prompt and no durable success or failure result
outcome: Resume on a session held in Engram Waiting/Unknown (begin-unknown) always produces a visible, durable outcome. Either the retained original prompt is retried (and delivered at most once), or the card and the session record state exactly why it cannot be retried and what the user can do instead. It never silently does nothing.
acceptance: The holder's note correlates, from host state and logs with locators, Greg's Resume click on session-11323 (about 16:16-16:38Z on 2026-10-09), the original begin-unknown prompt and its retained evaluate, any durable reconcile or retry record, the dispatch or admission outcome of the Resume, and the later manual prompt; and it names the code path that made the Resume a silent no-op.
A fail-first test reproduces a Resume on a begin-unknown held session that today yields no retry and no durable result.

With the fix, Resume either retries the retained original prompt (delivered at most once) or records a durable, user-visible refusal naming the reason; tests cover both outcomes and show the card never stays unchanged without a result.

The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree, and the change's relation to w-58cf44d04f2c landing 1b (which makes Resume replay the exact stored begin) is stated: fixed by 1b, fixed here, or both.
